_comment: Current measured performance of the posture-spec rules engine (real MediaPipeBackend) against the 8-fixture set in evaluation/manifest.csv. Regenerate with: for f in fixtures/images/*.jp*; do uv run python -m pose_backends.cli --report --json "$f"; done. Consumed by make validate-data for the class-distribution check and by the OP-60 threshold recalibration as the pre-change reference point.

known_gaps.issue: kneeling_right.jpg produces no kneeling-related finding at all — knee_flexion_deg measured at 80.3deg, inside the seated band (70-120deg) rather than triggering knee_kneeling_max_deg (<=60deg). Diagnosis: side-selection artifact, not a threshold miscalibration — the kneeling (right) leg is occluded, so require_either_side measures the visible left leg instead, which is not in a kneeling posture. No threshold value corrects for a leg that was never measured. knee_kneeling_max_deg confirmed at its current value.

arms_crossed abstains (low_confidence) on all 8 fixtures against the real backend, including the folded-arms positive case (straight_armsfolded.jpg) — it requires both wrists/elbows and every fixture here is lateral, so the far arm is always occluded. arms_crossed_ratio cannot currently be evaluated against this set at all; confirmed at its current value pending frontal/three-quarter fixtures or a one-armed-proxy design decision.

heel_contact_m measured 0.0065-0.0694m across the 8 fixtures. Two fixtures with no feet-support label (kneeling_right.jpg 0.069m, reclined_right.jpg 0.064m) exceed the one labelled dangling-feet case (bench_feet_dangling.jpg 0.063m). The manifest has no per-image feet-support ground truth, so heel_contact_tolerance_m (0.05m) is confirmed at its current value rather than retuned — the evidence argues against guessing, not for a specific new number. Needs a feet-support label added to evaluation/manifest.csv before a real recalibration is possible.

view_confidence measured 0.071-0.194 across the 8 (all-lateral) fixtures, comfortably under lateral_view_max_ratio (0.35) — that boundary is now genuinely validated. frontal_view_min_ratio (0.55) remains unvalidated: the evaluation set has no frontal or three-quarter fixture. Both confirmed at their current values.
